hook.say: Biggest, tallest, deepest, lowest. Five record breakers, three seconds each. Can you get five out of five?

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which is the largest ocean on Earth?
questions.fact: The Pacific is bigger than all of Earth's land put together.
questions.sayAnswer: The Pacific! It is bigger than all of the land on Earth put together.

questions.q: Which is the largest country in the world by area?
questions.fact: Russia covers about 17 million square km and spans 11 time zones.
questions.sayAnswer: Russia! It covers about 17 million square kilometers, and spans 11 time zones.

questions.q: Angel Falls, the world's tallest waterfall, is in which country?
questions.fact: The water drops 979 meters, almost as high as three Eiffel Towers.
questions.sayAnswer: Venezuela! The water drops 979 meters. That is almost as high as 3 Eiffel Towers.

questions.q: The deepest point in the ocean lies in which trench?
questions.fact: Its Challenger Deep is nearly 11 km down, deeper than Everest is tall.
questions.sayAnswer: The Mariana Trench! Its Challenger Deep is nearly 11 kilometers down. That is deeper than Mount Everest is tall.

questions.q: The lowest point on dry land is on the shore of which body of water?
questions.fact: The Dead Sea's shore lies more than 400 meters below sea level.
questions.sayAnswer: The Dead Sea! Its shore lies more than 400 meters below sea level.
